formal_branches.DECLARED_EXECUTABLE_EQUIVARIANT: preregistered sample-independent linear/affine A_g after identity/composition/inverse gates

residual.cosine_equality: PROHIBITED unless separately frozen projective interface; not implemented by this scorer

tolerance.coefficients: tau_abs=256*sqrt(D)*epsilon(dtype); tau_rel=tau_abs, where D is the submitted representation dimension and epsilon(dtype) is the IEEE machine epsilon of the declared output dtype
tolerance.dtype_policy: The declared output dtype is the dtype of the four-array representation submitted to the scorer. It is the formal precision basis for tolerance. Internal model arithmetic, including BF16 or FP16 autocast during Forward, does not alter epsilon unless it changes the declared submitted representation dtype.

point_estimator.weights: equal at each stated macro level
point_estimator.formal_score: F equals the invariant satisfaction fraction; no chance-centered transform is defined

uncertainty.method: nonparametric cluster bootstrap carrying complete parent/base/panel bundles

required_release_qc: hash-bound behavioral identity/composition/inverse operator evidence for equivariant branch
zero and nonzero constant invariant representations execute through the real evaluator and yield F=1
